notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org building a knowledge-layer for their web app (in-app help + smart search + auto-summaries). Trialled Redwood Hosted API for 6 weeks; now pushing to Dedicated for production predictability and cost control. Contact: CTO Ajay Rao; Product lead: Elena Park.

Trial highlights (hosted API):
- Trial period: 2025-05-19 to 2025-06-30.
- Primary endpoints exercised: chat/generation (support flows), document search (embeddings), and short-form summarization.
- Observed traffic: avg sustained QPS ~6 across all endpoints; daily peak QPS reached 22 (short spikes during morning digest).
- Token mix (measured): avg request tokens = 420 (prompt ~90, completion ~330). Token distribution: 60% chat/generation, 30% doc-search (embeddings), 10% reranking/small completions.
- Latency observed on Hosted: p50 ~120ms, p95 ~420ms for typical 256-512 token completions with batching enabled. Without batching p95 spiked to ~1.2s on peak.
- Cost/run rate using hosted pricing (trial): extrapolated monthly spend at current volume ~$9k/mo; projected production spend (3x growth) ~27k/mo unless optimized.

Business requirements / must-haves:
- p95 latency target for interactive support flows: <500ms for the 95th percentile (512-token average).
- Predictable monthly commit to control cost (prefers reserved/dedicated).
- VPC connectivity and audit logs required for compliance team.
- SSO (SAML) + KMS integration for key management.
- Data residency: customer data must be stored in NA region only.

Dedicated sizing & traffic forecasting notes (post-trial):
- Baseline observed: sustained QPS 6, peak QPS 22. Average concurrency seen during peak windows: ~45 concurrent inference streams.
- Expected growth: product roadmap driving higher automation -> forecast 3x baseline in 6 months (sustained QPS ~18, peak ~66).
- Token mix forecast stays ~420 tokens/request with heavier generation use on new feature rollout (+15% completion tokens).
- Redwood SE recommended starting Dedicated pool: 4 GPU nodes (A100-class equivalent) with autoscale up to 8 nodes for peak. Estimated capacity: ~60-80 QPS sustained for their token profile with batching + KV caching.
- Alternative conservative config: 6 smaller-GPU nodes with horizontal scaling (preferred by infra team for fault tolerance).
- Canary plan: 2-week canary with 2 dedicated nodes routed from 10% of traffic, monitor cost per token, p95 latency, and cache hit rates.

POC technical feedback (from Marcus Lee / SE notes):
- Batching helped reduce per-token latency by ~20% for doc-search heavy windows.
- KV/prefix caching gave substantial benefit on support flows (repeat queries), cache hit ~28% during trial which reduced tokens/second and latency.
- Model recommendations: use a 13B quantized variant for most flows, reserve 70B for occasional long-form summarization jobs with fallback to hosted if capacity constrained.

Commercial / pricing conversation:
- Redwood provided initial Dedicated pricing: commit tiers for 3, 6, 12 months. 12-month commit yields ~25% discount vs month-to-month hosted.
- Radiant Basin target: target unit economics must keep per-call cost <= $0.005 for support interactions. Current hosted extrapolate slightly above target at scale.
- Procurement asked for an itemized SOW + example invoice to submit PO. Legal flagged data residency and audit retention terms.

Quotes / call snippets:
- Ajay (CTO): "Latency is make-or-break — if we can't keep p95 under 500ms our UX will degrade."
- Elena (Product): "We need predictable bills; spikes kill our margins. Dedicated makes sense if we can prove cost per call under threshold."

Next steps (short list):
- AE (Sofia) to send final Dedicated SOW and pricing worksheet (by 2025-07-03).
- Schedule VPC peering test with infra (target window 2025-07-08).
- Legal & security to finish SLA and data residency clause (owner: Radiant legal).
- Start 2-week canary once PO received.

Stitch notes: CRM entries are terse — logs show multiple short Slack threads and a 45m demo on 2025-06-25 (drive transcript link above).

poc_summary: Hosted trial validated functional fit. Performance within acceptable bounds for p50; p95 approached UX limit during unbatched spikes. KV caching and batching materially improved economics. Recommendation to move to Dedicated with conservative autoscaling to ensure p95 SLAs and cost predictability.
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Start: 4 A100-class GPUs (or equivalent) in a dedicated pool with autoscale to 8 for peak. Canary: route 10% traffic to 2-node subset for 2 weeks. Expected headroom for 3x growth without immediate resize. If Radiant prefers smaller instances: 6 mid-tier GPUs with horizontal scaling. Monitor cache hit rate and tail latencies closely.
